title: Spectral geometry of Khovanov Laplacians
summary: For an oriented link diagram $D$, the Khovanov cochain complex carries a canonical Hermitian inner product that defines a combinatorial Hodge Laplacian. Its kernel is naturally isomorphic to rational Khovanov cohomology, while its positive spectrum depends on the chosen diagram. Building on the numerical work of Jones and Wei, we develop a structural study of this diagram-dependent higher spectrum.
